rationale: The agent did not follow key policy requirements. It performed write actions (exchanging an item and updating the default address) without first confirming with the user. There is no evidence of proper user authentication beyond an email lookup. It also revealed the full Washington, DC address in the final message even though the user explicitly did not want to reveal it. Additionally, the final response did not confirm or summarize the exchange outcome (e.g., which order/item was changed to red half-zip, any costs or timelines), failing to provide correct and complete final information. These issues violate the pass criteria.
